The '''XL-Lioness''' was a variant of the [[TDL nanny droid]]. Unlike the base model, the XL-Lioness incorporated [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] into its design and was marketed towards celebrities and politicians who were concerned about their children's safety.

==Characteristics==
The XL-Lioness was a version of the standard [[TDL nanny droid]] manufactured by [[AccuTronics/Legends|AccuTronics]]. In addition to the standard features of the TDL, it incorporated two hidden [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] built into the lower pair of [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. The hands were removable, allowing the blasters to be deployed.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
The XL-Lioness was marketed to celebrities and politicians who had reason to believe that their children could be the target of a kidnapping scheme. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] purchased an XL-Lioness to protect her children at the [[Anoth Base|hidden base]] on [[Anoth/Legends|Anoth]]. She had the droid modified beyond its original specifications, adding a second pair of concealed blasters, one in each arm, and a [[laser screen]] that was capable of protecting the children from enemy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.<ref name="EGTD" />
